limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Flow Launcher delegates primary updates to Squirrel and has a separate plugin update channel. The reviewed application wrapper does not establish the dependency’s complete integrity policy, so the asserted verification classification remains unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; Squirrel's internal verification and release artifact properties were not audited, and no network or exploitability testing was performed.
